explanation: Warren Beatty and Faye Dunaway had been handed the wrong envelope: the Best Actress card, which Emma Stone had just won for La La Land.

claims.text: At the 2017 Academy Awards, La La Land was announced as Best Picture by mistake, and Moonlight was the actual winner.
Hidden Figures, Arrival and Manchester by the Sea were nominated but were not the film wrongly announced.
Presenters Warren Beatty and Faye Dunaway were handed the envelope for Best Actress instead of Best Picture.
Emma Stone had just won Best Actress for La La Land that night.
